items.reason: Gap 0 describes two deliveries of the same event running concurrently so both pass the Set check before the id is recorded and the handler runs twice.
Gap 1 says the signature covers only the body, so keying on the X-Event-Id header lets a validly signed body be replayed with a different header.
Gap 2 says the provider sends charge.refunded while HANDLERS registers only refund.created, so refunds are dropped.
No gap depends on several processes or instances; the concurrency raised is within the one process's queue.
